message: Last month, we had a surprise blackout that left me feeling a bit in the dark—literally! Thankfully, I had my trusty power bank charged up and my favorite lantern ready to go. I set up a cozy little space in the living room with snacks and a game, and we ended up having the best impromptu family night. Sometimes, a little prep work can turn an inconvenient moment into a delightful memory. Have you had any unexpected fun during a power outage?
